trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done. Everything is single-player: no online trophies, no DLC, no difficulty setting, and one playthrough is enough. [1][8]
steps: Earn every other trophy in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. The 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) appears after the story, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. [5] It does not ask for everything: robberies in full (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks are required in full, while only a share of the rest counts — 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. [5] KeenGamer's checklist breakdown counts the same robberies as 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 bank vault robberies, plus 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos. [2] PowerPyx puts the checklist closer to 60% true completion. [1]
steps: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through what is left.
Finish the full-requirement items first: all robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, underwater discoveries, shooting range golds, drone races and Bret's Target Decks.
Top up the partial items to their counts: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies, 15 meditations, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans. [5]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story. Free roam carries on afterwards, so you can clean up everything else after the credits. There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission. [5] Note: sources disagree on the wording — some lists call it the Chapter 5 finale instead of the final mission. [4]
steps: Finish the final story mission.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. [5] Progress > Activities > Stunts shows your count, and the map can show every Stunt Spot. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going. [5]
steps: Complete any 250 stunts — under-bridge flights are the fastest way to build the count. [5]
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist. [5]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. [5] There are two ranges in Leonida: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero); most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold. [6] Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. [5]
steps: Visit both shooting ranges (Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn, Griffin in Balsero) and gold every challenge. [6]
Earn all 42 gold medals across the 12 ranges. [5]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. [5] Note: sources disagree on the grade — GTABase and eGamers list it as Silver, while PushSquare's text labels it Bronze. [5][4][6]
steps: Open vaults with the optional Chapter 4 mission, then rob 5 of the 8 vaults and escape. [5]
Rob all 8 vaults for the 100% checklist. [5]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. [5] None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story. [5] Watch: Yago's race in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive — save first. [7] Note: sources disagree on exactly which strands qualify. [5]
steps: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. [5]
Save before Yago's Chapter 3 race; it is time-sensitive. [7]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. There are 18 sets in the game. [6] The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. [5] If you are going for 100% Completion, you will unlock this along the way, as 15 sets are required there. [6] Cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and will still count toward your progress. [6]
steps: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. [6]
Keep collecting toward 15 sets for the 100% checklist. [6]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. [5] WAiNK is an app on Jason's or Lucia's smartphone, opened by holding Up. [6] Check your progress at any time under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. [6]
steps: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 / RB). [5]
Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. [6]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. [5]
steps: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. [5]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? [5]
steps: Complete Chapter 1. [5]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City. [5]
steps: Complete Chapter 2. [5]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. [5]
steps: Complete Chapter 3. [5]
Play the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach, Another Life) for the trophy to pop. [5]

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It cannot be missed. [5]
steps: Complete Chapter 4. [5]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. [5]
steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. [5]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. [5]
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. [5]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. [5]
steps: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. [5]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. [5]
steps: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. [5]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. [5]
steps: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. [5]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. [5]
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. [5]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. [5] Progress > Activities shows what is left. Most of these come naturally. [5]
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade, a race win and a stunt. [5]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so you may as well finish each location while you are there. [5] There are 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations in GTA 6, and some of them require entry fees. [6]
steps: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. [5]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from. Winning the same race again does not count. [5] You can keep track of them all under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. [6] Most race locations will let you hire cars; pay attention to your car's Rating if you plan to use your own. [6]
steps: Win 20 different races — repeats do not count. [5]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. [5] You will need a boat with a fishing rod to complete this, but there are plenty in the area you can hijack if you do not have your own. [6]
steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1) and follow his fishing quests. [5]
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge. [5]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. [5]
steps: Reach the end of any one arcade game. [5]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story. [5]
steps: Do Andy's five Lucia-only quests in order, starting in Chapter 3. [5]
Finish the last one, Puff Puff Pass, for the trophy. [5]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. [5]
steps: Recover treasure from Kenton's 7 shipwrecks, diving at the purple chest markers. [5]
Finish his final mission when he texts Jason again later. [5]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story. [5]
steps: Do Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, starting after Coffee Break. [5]
Finish the fifth, Hometown Heroes, for the trophy. [5]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more. [5]
steps: Unlock Randy's Wish List after the Chapter 3 Key Cloner mission. [5]
Deliver all 16 sports cars on his list to his west Vice City garage. [5]

trophies.name: Spin on This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy. [5]
steps: Destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs around Vice City for Tyrone. [5]
Finish his last job, Shut Down the Labs. [5]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. [5] Possibly missable: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it. [5] KeenGamer's Step 1 gives the same warning: after Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation, before leaving Chapter 1. [2] Sources disagree on the count: guides say 18 meditations for the trophy while the 100% list says 15, and whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required is still unconfirmed. Do all 18 and keep a Chapter 1 manual save. [5][1]
steps: Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations across Leonida, with both Jason and Lucia. [3][1]
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house BEFORE Chapter 1 ends — it is gone after it. This is the one possibly missable trophy in the game. [1][3]
The last meditation cannot be done until both leads play together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. [5]

Sources disagree on the count: guides say 18 meditations for the trophy while the 100% list says 15, and whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required is still unconfirmed. Do all 18 and keep a Chapter 1 manual save. [1][3]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway. [5]
steps: Start Bret's hunting quests after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 (Veteran Hunted). [5]
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason. [5]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way. [5] There are 80 Challenges in the game and you will need to complete 50 for this trophy; 70 must be completed for 100% Completion. [6]
steps: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges (70 for the 100% checklist). [5]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there. [5]
steps: With your partner, get a 4-star Wanted Level (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). [5]
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well. [5]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth. [5]
steps: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted. [5]
The north Vice City jewelry stores (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) are close together — use them. [5]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway. [5] You will automatically discover a vehicle when you get inside one or when you scan one. [6]
steps: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app. [5]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. [5]
steps: Fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer). [5]
Take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus — gang operation thugs work best. [5]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. [5]
steps: At VCIA, steal a passenger jet from a departure gate (E3/E4 are easiest) and fly about 1 km away. [5]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. [5]
steps: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station (south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it. [5]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. [5]
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. [5]
Open a jewelry store's back door with it, find the safe code note, and empty the safe unseen. [5]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. [5]
steps: Rob an armored truck (sticky bomb on its back doors) or a bank vault, then escape. [5]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch. [5]
steps: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida — flying over it by plane is fastest. [5]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39. [5]
steps: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs. [5]
Keep going to all 39 for the 100% checklist. [5]

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. [5] The exact steps are not confirmed yet. [5]
steps: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. [5]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. [5] The exact steps are not confirmed yet. [5]
steps: Crash a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. [5]

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back. [5]
steps: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2). [5]
Take its three valuables — the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the safe — then lose the police. [5]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. [5]
steps: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at fitness clubs. [5]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent. [5]
steps: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — most players get it without trying. [5]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: "Second time's the charm" suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. [5] The exact steps are not confirmed yet. [5]
steps: Succeed at something on a second attempt. [5]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. [5] The exact steps are not confirmed yet. [5]
steps: Find the strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. [5]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). [5] The exact steps are not confirmed yet. [5]
steps: Knock people down with a melee attack from a vehicle. [5]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there. [5]
steps: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (Yasmani in Vice City pays most). [5]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest. [5]
steps: Spend a running total of $100,000 across all shops. [5]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. [5]
steps: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app (after Daily Driver in Chapter 2). [5]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. [5]
steps: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app at Moses' Port Gellhorn garage. [5]
